title: courier-declustering-OA: simulator and pre-registered benchmark of dispatch models for clusters of idle couriers
description: Open-access code of the study "Preventing and Undoing Clusters of Idle Couriers in Meal Delivery: A Pre-Registered Simulation Benchmark of Dispatch Models". It holds an event-driven simulator of evening meal deliveries in Curitiba, Brazil; ten dispatch models (nine published models and nearest-courier dispatch) with their fidelity notes and known-answer tests; the run and analysis scripts; the two pre-registrations and their three addenda; and the aggregate results behind the paper's numbers and figures. The Meituan trajectory data are not redistributed; only fitted parameters and aggregate moments are included.
